MicroGPT in the Browser

This is a browser port of Andrej Karpathy's dependency-free MicroGPT in 200 lines of Python gist, running in Pyodide inside a Web Worker so training does not freeze the page. For better convergence this version adds mini-batch updates, warmup + cosine learning-rate decay, and gradient clipping. The model learns to generate names.

Training Controls

This dataset contains first names, one name per line.
